reason: 该插件面向 DSH 的编辑侧边栏体验，通过在每个标签页工具栏中加入“打开所在文件夹”入口，按标签自身路径定位文件并调用本地文件管理器打开其目录，属于面向导航面板的文件定位工具增强，证据来自仓库说明、功能清单与安装/依赖描述。

summaries.zh: 在 dsh-better-sidebar 的每个编辑标签工具栏中加入“打开所在文件夹”按钮，点击即可在本地文件管理器中定位到该标签对应文件所在目录。
summaries.en: Adds an Open Containing Folder button to each dsh-better-sidebar editor tab so one click opens the current tab’s file location in the local file explorer.

capabilities: Injects a per-tab button into dsh-better-sidebar editor toolbar chrome
Reads the open file path from each tab context to target the corresponding file
Invokes host-side logic to reveal/open the file location in a local file explorer
Runs a DOM healing/retry flow to handle duplicate or stale UI elements after layout changes

reasons.code: README describes one "open containing folder" button per editor tab, embedded in each tab toolbar and tied to that tab’s own file path.
README states Windows-only integration using explorer.exe /select and path handling for local filenames with spaces/Unicode, indicating local system interaction.
Repository/package purpose text identifies the plugin as a folder reveal helper for files open in dsh-better-sidebar editor tabs.
